camel_example: aliyun ndr CreatePrivateTractionFilterRule --region cn-hangzhou --RuleName '仅采集业务流量' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a private network traffic mirroring filter rule. You can configure both inbound and outbound sub-rules at the same time
description_zh: 创建一条私网引流过滤规则，可同时配置入方向和出方向子规则
kebab_example: aliyun ndr create-private-traction-filter-rule --rule-name '仅采集业务流量' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePrivateTractionFilterRule

parameters.help_en: The filter rule name. The name must be fewer than 128 characters and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 过滤规则名称。少于 128 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.example: 采集指定网段的 TCP 流量
parameters.help_en: The filter rule description. The description must be fewer than 256 characters and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: 过滤规则描述。少于 256 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
parameters.name: rule_description

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block. Use CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP protocols
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The network protocol to match. ALL indicates all protocols. ICMP, TCP, and UDP indicate the corresponding protocols
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block. Use CIDR notation. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required for TCP or UDP protocols
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en: The action to take on matched traffic. A value of accept indicates that the traffic is collected. A value of drop indicates that the traffic is not collected
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action
